Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. 3 mm intra-articular body posterior to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Large Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique radial tear of the posterior horn/root of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion. There is degenerative signal within the meniscal body.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild loss of cartilage along the posterior medial femoral condyle with small subchondral cysts and marrow edema. There is mild subchondral marrow edema in the medial portion of the medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: 10 mm full thickness cartilage defect in the central femoral trochlea with subchondral marrow edema. Minimal subchondral marrow edema at the median ridge of the patella.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact. Edema signal surrounds the ligament.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 6 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Oblique radial tear of the posterior horn/root of the medial meniscus with mild meniscal extrusion.
2. Patellofemoral osteoarthritis with full thickness cartilage defect in the central femoral trochlea.
3. Mild medial compartment osteoarthritis.
4. Moderate knee joint effusion and large Baker's cyst.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Disfunción patelofemoral izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura. Aumento de señal
del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar con la superficie
articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
No se observan lesiones condrales categóricas de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la
tróclea femoral. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la faceta medial de la rótula, sin cambios
óseos secundarios.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales. El
discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica

MRI of right Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc RT, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Screen Save



> Wearing of articular cartilage of patella and subchondral cysts and edema, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia, major at lateral facet.
  Slight fraying and increased signal intensity of femoral trochlea, reflecting grade 2 chondromalacia. 
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
  Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Incomplete seperation of lateral meniscus into anterior and posterior horn, indicative of discoid meniscus.
> No evidence of tear in medial meniscus.
> Mild synovitis of right knee and tiny Baker's cyst with fat stranding over medial popliteal fossa; medial patellar plica.
> Mild patellar enthesophyte and tendinosis of quadricepes tendon.
> Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior aspect of right knee.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right patellofemoral joint with grade 3-4 patellar chondromalacia and grade 2 chondromalacia of femoral trochlea.
2. Mild synovitis of right knee with medial patellar plica and tiny Baker's cyst.
3. Discoid lateral meniscus.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Subchondrale knöcherne Impression am dorsolateralen Tibiaplateau (6/24) sowie der lateralen Femurkondyle bereits in der VU vordokumentiert, mit Restbefunden. Zeichen einer DD Inaktivitätsosteopenie subchondral und gelenknah betont, exemplarisch in der lateralen Femurkondyle. Ansonsten in den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen. An der lateralen Femurkondyle nach lateral abflachender Knorpelbesatz ohne höhergradige Chondropathie. Ansonsten kein Anhalt für eine Chondropathie. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus mit regelrechter Signalgebung ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. Bei bei klinisch und anamnestisch vordokumentierter subtotaler Ruptur des vorderen Kreuzbandes das VKB am femoralen Ansatz aufgefasert und verdickt imponierend, soweit mit der externen MR-VU vergleichbar kein Hinweis auf eine weitere Ruptur. Bekannte Ruptur des HKB (6/17). Bei initial Partialläsion des Außenbandes das LCL gering aufgefasert und verdickt imponierend ohne eindeutige Kontinuitätsunterbrechung. MCL mit intakter Darstellung. Regredienter Gelenkerguss mit geringem Rest. Intakte Signalgebung der Patellar- sowie Quadrizepssehne. Die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS, SG T1W

> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn and body of lateral meniscus, and unclear contour of meniscal root, lateral extrusion of lateral meniscus, in favor of tear.
> Mild interstitial increased signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration.
> Increased infiltration over medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
> Effusion in popliteal bursa, in favor of popliteal bursitis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis; deep infrapatellar  bursitis.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of right knee and tiny spur and subchondral cyst.
> Full thickness of patellar cartilage loss with underlying bone reactive hyperintense change especially at lateral facet, reflecting Grade IV chondromalacia.
> Patellar osteophyte. 
> In favor of dilatation of the superficial vessel with focal engorgment noted in posterior aspect of right knee and semimembranosus muscle, in favor of  varicose veins.
> Subcutaneous edema in anterior aspect of right knee.
> The contour of PCL and LCL within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.

Impression:
1. Tear of posterior horn of lateral meniscus.
2. C/W osteroarthritis of right knee with grade IV chondromalacia, major at patellofemoral joint.
3. A big Baker's cyst and popliteal cyst.
4. Synovitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; suprapatellar, infrapatellar and popliteal bursitis.
5. R/O grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration of ACL.
6. Subcutaneous edema in anterior aspect of right knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial joint pain for 20 years, no known cause. No surgical history.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Area of full-thickness chondrosis along the posterior weightbearing medial femoral condyle extending to the posterior nonweightbearing condyle with subchondral bone marrow edema and cystic change. The tibial plateau is within normal limits.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness fissuring at the posterolateral tibial plateau with subchondral cystic change.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness fissuring at the medial patellar facet with subchondral edema. Low-grade fissuring at the junction of the lateral facet and median ridge. Focal full-thickness fissuring along the inferomedial trochlea with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal tendinosis with insertional enthesopathy.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Tricompartmental chondrosis, moderate in the medial compartment.

2. No acute osseous, ligamentous or meniscal injury.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon izleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyale 4 mm ekstrüde medyal menisküs arka kökünde parsiyel yırtık ve arka boynuz dejenerasyonu mevcut. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Posteromedyal köşede pes anserinus tendonlarının derinindeki hafif ödem posteromedyal sıkışma sendromunu telkin ediyor. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem sıvısı hafif artmış.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Esguince.
Hallazgos:
Edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral medial, sin fenómenos que sugieran fracturas
categórica subcorticales regionales. No hay otras alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula
ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones. Aumento de señal de las partes blandas
que rodean al componente superficial del complejo ligamentario medial en su inserción proximal,
inespecífico. Los componentes superficial y profundo del complejo medial impresionan sin
alteraciones.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites conservados.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Edema óseo periférico del cóndilo femoral medial sin fracturas categóricas, probablemente post
contusional.
Edema de las partes blandas que rodean al componente superficial del complejo ligamentario
medial en su inserción proximal, inespecífico
